_source: ArsenalRules: the weapons and items and the numbers they play by (2013 original globals.gml; see Arsenal.cs). start 10 is unlimited. Ids are the Weapon and Item enum names, in the original's order. about is the hover text of its HUD icon (U.RICO-T49: the rebuild's own words; the original's icons had none).

weapons.name: Cannon
weapons.about: Fires a shell that ricochets off the walls and shapes until its bounces run out.

weapons.name: Laser
weapons.about: A fast beam that ricochets like a shell and hits whoever it reaches.

weapons.name: Shotgun
weapons.about: Fires a spray of pellets around your aim; the first pellet to hit does a full hit.

weapons.name: Grenade
weapons.about: Bounces until its fuse runs out, then blasts everyone near it. Set the fuse with 1-3.

weapons.name: Railgun
weapons.about: A slug that flies near enough instantly along your aim.

weapons.name: Vortex Device
weapons.about: Fire it, then press Space again to set it off: it flings the shapes near it, and one that hits you hurts.

items.name: Extra Bounce
items.about: Your shot bounces one more time this turn.

items.name: Shield Wall
items.about: Raises a wall across your aim that only your own shots pass; anyone else's shatters it.

items.name: Shrink Ray
items.about: Fires a ray that shrinks whoever it hits for the rest of the round.

items.name: Teleporter
items.about: Flies along your aim and puts you down where it lands.

items.name: Aim Assist
items.about: Turns your aim onto a shot that hits someone.

items.name: Redirector
items.about: Places an arrow that turns any shot crossing it the way it points.
